intro: The Reports marks the culmination of mountaineer scouting efforts against the Frostmane trolls in southern Dun Morogh. Carrying Senir Whitebeard's official dispatch from Kharanos to the high halls of Ironforge, an Alliance courier discovers that local field operations have sparked fierce political friction between King Magni Bronzebeard and the dwarven Senate.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Excellent! Take my report to Senator Barin Redstone. He's a sour type, so don't let his less-than-sunny disposition get to you. He's in Ironforge, in the chamber where King Magni holds court.
Don't know the way to Ironforge? Take the road out of Kharanos north, cross the bridge, then follow the road east—there are large banners flanking the road—up the mountainside.
By the way, if you might avoid mentioning how you assisted me? Can't let them think I'm not working hard out here, you know?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hmm... It would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Authority of the KING!? Has Magni taken complete leave of his senses! And that damnable Whitebeard... Taken matters into his own hands, has he? The Senate will not be pleased to hear about this, not one bit.
What, are you still here? Go, before I call the guards!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
